vendor_snapshot.note: Original upstream snapshot is not established; this release performs no whole-tree synchronization.

local_adaptations.application: Allow the existing file scanner for Codex without changing other terminal editors or mouse-reporting policy.

local_adaptations.scope: Complete Chinese and wrapped file-reference ranges
local_adaptations.application: Preserve both cells of wide characters, complete suffixes, soft/hard wraps, spaces and consecutive path lists. Retain existing file validation and opener.

local_adaptations.scope: Relative paths in the associated Codex session
local_adaptations.application: Use the pane PTY PID and a unique descendant Codex process. Explicit -C/--cd takes precedence; otherwise use the associated rollout or exact fresh read-only state row. Skip relative references for unknown/ambiguous contexts. No global latest-session lookup, prompt injection, or session-content logging.

preservation.feature_baseline: Complete 0.0.13 Mac features, retaining 0.0.11 custom behavior and selected 0.0.12 backports
preservation.windows_note: This is the Mac build record. The release platform manifest records a separate Windows rebuild with unchanged runtime source and a 0.0.14 version label.

acceptance_reference.gui: Aggregate user-reported root/worktree mouse pass; no independent screenshot or mouse-control observation.

limits: Unknown or ambiguous Codex directory context skips relative links.
Default shared-daemon mode without explicit -C is outside verified relative-link support.
Reconstruction is bounded to eight physical rows and 8192 bytes.
Older Codex state schemas and directory changes inside the TUI are not exhaustively verified.
Older operating systems, physical phone/Tailscale and real provider credentials remain unverified.
